Create a parent component `CheckoutWizard` that owns the **current step index** (0-based: `0`, `1`, `2`) as state.\n2. Each step is a **separate child component** (`CartReview`, `DeliveryDetails`, `OrderSummary`).\n3. `CheckoutWizard` decides **which step component to render** based on the current step index.\n4. `CartReview` must receive an `onNext` callback prop (passed down from `CheckoutWizard`) that advances the wizard to step 1 when the user clicks a **"Proceed to Delivery"** button. The child **cannot directly mutate** the parent's step state — it must call the prop.\n5. Create a `DeliveryContext` using `createContext`. Its value should hold `{ delivery, setDelivery }` where `delivery` is an object `{ name: '', address: '' }`.\n7. The `delivery` state and `setDelivery` updater must **live in `CheckoutWizard`** (or a dedicated provider component wrapping it). Thank you, {name}."** message instead of the step components.\n\n### Part C — Controlled vs. Uncontrolled Awareness\n\n10. Add a **"Back"** button to both `DeliveryDetails` and `OrderSummary` that calls an `onBack` prop to go to the previous step. This tests that event-handler props can flow down just like data props.\n\n---\n\n## Constraints\n\n- Use **React functional components** only.\n- Use **`useState`** for all state.\n- Use **`createContext`** and **`useContext`** for the delivery data — do not pass `delivery` or `setDelivery` as explicit props.\n- Do **not** use `useReducer`, `useRef`, or any external library.\n- Each child component must be a **named, separately-defined function** (not an inline anonymous component).\n- `CartReview` must display the items it receives **via props** — it must not read from context.\n\n---\n\n## Example Rendered Behavior\n\n```\n[Step 1 — Cart Review]\nItems:\n  • Wireless Headphones — $49.99\n  • USB-C Hub — $29.99\n  • Laptop Stand — $39.99\n[Proceed to Delivery]\n\n[Step 2 — Delivery Details]\nName: ____________\nAddress: __________\n[← Back]  [Review Order →]\n\n[Step 3 — Order Summary]\nDelivering to: Jane Doe, 42 Elm Street\nItems: (same list)\nTotal: $119.97\n[← Back]  [Place Order]\n\n[After clicking Place Order]\n✅ Order placed! Thank you, Jane Doe.\n```\n\n---\n\n## Starter Scaffold (optional — you may ignore and write from scratch)\n\n```jsx\nimport { useState, createContext, useContext } from 'react';\n\n// TODO: Create DeliveryContext here\n\nconst CART_ITEMS = [\n  { id: 1, name: 'Wireless Headphones', price: 49.99 },\n  { id: 2, name: 'USB-C Hub', price: 29.99 },\n  { id: 3, name: 'Laptop Stand', price: 39.99 },\n];\n\nfunction CartReview({ items, onNext }) {\n  // TODO\n}\n\nfunction DeliveryDetails({ onNext, onBack }) {\n  // TODO: consume DeliveryContext\n}\n\nfunction OrderSummary({ cartItems, onNext, onBack }) {\n  // TODO: consume DeliveryContext\n}\n\nexport default function CheckoutWizard() {\n  // TODO: own step state, delivery state, orderPlaced state\n  // TODO: provide DeliveryContext\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n**Good luck!**",
